services.desc: For members who wish to play Saturday night and Sunday, buy this package. We often offer discounts; check our Facebook page for discount codes that are valid until Friday night.Weekend schedule:Saturday night 6 PM to 11 PMSunday 9 AM to 4 PMPlease note that the chalet opens 1 hour before the scheduled times. - - - - - - - - On this page, you are purchasing a member access to an airsoft event. If you aren't a member, you will then have to pay the difference on the day of the event. Please note that we do not rent any airsoft guns (toys); you must bring your own equipment. However, you can rent masks or clothing on-site if needed. We have a small pro shop on-site with consumables such as BBs,
